evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips straight into 'Alright. Okay sounds good. So let's review everything here' with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote before launching probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Ammar), date (Sunday October 11th), addresses (1110 Aspen Grove, Flugerville to unspecified destination), size (1500 sq ft, two story, three bedrooms) all gathered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'any questions or any concerns before we jump into the estimate' only after all logistics probing is complete — not before, and phrased as a closed throwaway.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house), floors (two story), rooms (three bedrooms), walking distance not explicitly stated, additional rooms/special considerations covered through detailed inventory (washer/dryer, sofa, mattresses, dressers, crib, nightstands, desk, coffee table, bookshelves), additional stops not mentioned but move is partial so not applicable.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: No packing offer made. Rep mentions wrapping furniture for protection but does not ask 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: No box-count anchor or overflow check offered. Customer volunteered 'less than five' boxes but rep did not ask the scripted question about typical count.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives range: '1500 square foot home usually takes six to eight hours...in your case...three to five hours...around $630 to $1,050' and personalizes to partial move (large furniture only, disassemble/wrap/reassemble). Full anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep covers: hourly rate $210 (includes gas, truck, taxes, insurance), wrapping and padding included, disassemble/reassemble included, no hidden fees (no credit card, transportation, disassemble, storage fees), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments. Full transparency and 'not a guess' framing delivered.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep asks 'Does that feel fair?' Customer responds 'Okay...absolutely. Yeah, I've used Dell before and so I think everything sounds great.' Rep does not talk over; silence is held and customer fills it.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned anywhere in the call. No On-Time Guarantee or discount-if-late framing provided.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Not mentioned anywhere in the call. No No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or 'built into the rate' statement provided.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm Two Promises. No loop closure on the guarantees.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep moves directly to booking confirmation with no genuine 'What's still concerning you?' check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' before booking.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks plainly: 'Would you like our help with your move?' with no soft out or alternative offered. Customer says 'Oh, absolutely. Yes, yes, yes.' Full explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states 'We also have afternoon availability too' and mentions no deposit required, confirming rate lock implicitly but not using the phrase 'rate lock' explicitly. Treated as mentioned given 'no deposit' framing.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Confirmed: date (Sunday October 11th), time window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), no deposit mentioned. Missing: destination address (only origin address stated), specific crew size (not confirmed), arrival window is given but customer states he needs to confirm with wife and may call back. Phone number for callback given but not explicitly confirmed as the contact number for the move day. Partial confirmation only.

top_strength: Rep flawlessly gathered a comprehensive and detailed inventory of items to be moved through natural dialogue, asking follow-up questions to capture specifics (mattress sizes, dresser dimensions, shelf locations), which will ensure accurate estimating despite the partial-move complexity.
coaching_note: Skip the quid pro quo entirely and jump to probing—this call never frames the 10–15 minute time investment or anchors 'a quote you can depend on' before diving into discovery, and you missed both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage) that should have closed the pitch before the ask.
